title: tc-account-list
description:
The financial accounts linked to a person or a company – institution, type, a masked identifier shown one at a time,
an amount and a status each (Monitored, Flagged, Under review, Closed or your own), with the page's stats above.

stats.description: Stats shown in a strip above the list: { id, label, value, detail? }

statuses.description: Statuses' names and tones, merged over the defaults (monitored, flagged, review, closed, cleared)

masked.description: Masks identifiers to their last four characters until revealed; set false to show them in full

revealed.description: The ids whose identifiers are shown. Changed by the user unless a tc-revealed-change listener calls preventDefault()

currency.description: The currency for amounts that don't name their own, e.g. "EUR"

locale.description: The language for amounts, e.g. "fr-FR"; by default the browser's

branch.description: Where it sits: a branch or a city, "Lyon"

type.description: What kind of account it is: "Personal current", "Business operating", "Offshore-linked"

number.description: The identifier, IBAN-style; masked to its last four characters unless `masked` is off or it's revealed

status.description: A key of `statuses`: monitored, flagged, review, closed, or one of the page's own

amount.description: An amount to show on the row, with what it is: { value: 240000, label: "Flagged · 90 days" }

note.description: One quiet line: "Opened three weeks before the first transfer"

AccountStat.description: A stat in the strip above the list

AccountTone.description: The tone a status is drawn in
